facts.fact: Heads of Djibouti Telecom, Ethio Telecom and Sudatel signed in Djibouti on Wednesday 4 February 2026 the agreement launching Horizon, a terrestrial fibre corridor of nearly 2,800 km with 144 fibre pairs joining Djibouti, Addis Ababa and Port Sudan.
A memorandum of understanding for Horizon was signed in Addis Ababa on 4 December 2024.

facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports that Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel signed a tripartite contractual agreement in Djibouti on 4 February 2026 to implement Horizon Fiber, a cross-border optical fibre corridor linking Djibouti's submarine cable landing stations through Ethiopia into Sudan.

BTW Media's 10 September 2026 analysis says the Horizon partners presented the project to prospective users in Addis Ababa (per La Nation, 9 September) and that the report reviewed announces no capacity purchase, paying customer or service start date.

BTW Media states the official announcement of 4 February 2026 describes a multi-terabit terrestrial fibre corridor joining the submarine cable landing stations in Djibouti to those in Sudan via Ethiopia.

slug: 2026-02-04 Sudatel-Djibouti Telecom-Ethio telecom launch Horizon Fiber cross-border initiative (SUNA)

facts.fact: SUNA, the Sudanese state news agency, reports Sudatel signed a strategic agreement with Djibouti Telecom and Ethio telecom on 4 February 2026 launching Horizon Fiber, a terrestrial fibre corridor linking Djibouti's international submarine cable stations through Ethiopia to Sudan.

Ethio telecom's press release says it, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel signed a tripartite strategic agreement on 4 February 2026 under the Horizon Fiber Initiative for a terrestrial fibre corridor joining Djibouti's submarine cable landing stations, across Ethiopia, to Sudan's, building on a memorandum signed in Addis Ababa on 3 December 2024.

facts.fact: La Nation reports that Djibouti Telecom, Ethio telecom and Sudatel signed a tripartite agreement in Djibouti on 4 February 2026 for the construction and maintenance of the Horizon terrestrial cross-border fibre link joining Djibouti, Ethiopia and Sudan.

La Nation reports that the three operators presented Horizon to hyperscalers, carriers and vendors at a pre-commercialisation meeting in Addis Ababa on Monday 7 September 2026, ahead of deployment and commercial launch, so the link was not yet in service.
